Sanofi (SNY) Holder Fulton Bank Lowered Its Holding; Selway Asset Management Has Lifted Schlumberger LTD (SLB) Position by $808,958
May 26, 2018 - By wolcottdaily
Selway Asset Management increased its stake in Schlumberger Ltd (SLB) by 28% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Selway Asset Management bought 12,074 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.39% with the market. The institutional investor held 55,200 shares of the oilfield services and equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.72M, up from 43,126 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Selway Asset Management who had been investing in Schlumberger Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $95.02B market cap company. The stock decreased 3.68% or $2.62 during the last trading session, reaching $68.6. About 10.72 million shares traded or 53.33% up from the average. Schlumberger Limited (NYSE:SLB) has declined 16.28% since May 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.83% the S&P500.
Fulton Bank decreased its stake in Sanofi (SNY) by 34.02% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fulton Bank sold 27,963 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.41% with the market. The institutional investor held 54,237 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.33 million, down from 82,200 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fulton Bank who had been investing in Sanofi for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $95.72B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.93% or $0.36 during the last trading session, reaching $38.28. About 561,588 shares traded. Sanofi (NYSE:SNY) has declined 13.31% since May 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 24.86% the S&P500.
Fulton Bank, which manages about $1.42 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Cognizant Technology Solutio (NASDAQ:CTSH) by 7,583 shares to 31,416 shares, valued at $2.23 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Nationwide Mut Fds New by 5,716 shares in the quarter, for a total of 87,027 shares, and has risen its stake in Cisco Sys Inc (NASDAQ:CSCO).
